demonstratedNeed: metric compilation: the released metric contract exists as a versioned JSON document, but no executable component compiles it into a bounded, channel-preserving plan for the released read path. Exactly one concrete reuse gap, no catalog platform and no second dashboard engine.

dependencySet.note: no new dependency; the adapter imports only the released read-path module

candidates.reason: it compiles the released contract without a new dependency, preserves every bounded channel, refuses every unsupported dialect by name and round-trips losslessly

a server-shaped semantic layer with 19 direct dependencies, a cubestore driver and an >=20 engine range against a legacy runtime is not adoptable for ONE synthetic integer-cent metric without a fair executed comparison; it was never installed or executed here, so vendor compatibility is unverified and is not assumed

a language compiler whose grammar and numeric semantics differ from the contract arithmetic would need a fair executed comparison and a stable license/version decision; it was never installed or executed here, so compatibility is unverified and is not assumed

driftPolicy: Source drift is detected against the pinned contract digest and refuses rather than silently recompiling.
positiveCases: integer minor units with no floating point anywhere in the contract
cancel rows contribute exactly zero and are validated first
UNKNOWN, DENIED and observed-ABSENCE channels carried as first-class entries
unsupported dialects refused by name with their exact reason
falsifyingCases: a one-cent contract change is DRIFT_DETECTED, not recompiled
a dialect outside the supported set is UNSUPPORTED_DIALECT
a channel without a count, period or reason is CHANNEL_COLLAPSED

rollbackAndMigration.rollback: delete the adapter module, its CLI, its suite and its fixtures; no dependency, lockfile, schema migration, data migration or runtime change is involved, so rollback is a plain revert
rollbackAndMigration.migrationToAnExternalCompiler: deferred, not preapproved: it would require an installed and actually executed comparison, a pinned version and license decision, and a channel-preservation proof before any adoption

verdict: ADOPT the in-repo bounded metric-IR adapter for this one reuse gap; REJECT both observed external components as unverified and unmeasured for this scope.
nonclaims: No vendor adoption, installation or compatibility claim.
No general compiler, catalog or dashboard capability claim.
A rejection here is a decision with evidence, not an implemented capability and not a claim that the rejected component is defective.
